story_type: pilotless jet launches from and lands on an aircraft carrier
hook: No pilot aboard, and it is launching off a carrier.
narration: There is no pilot in this jet, and it is about to launch off an aircraft carrier.
This is the Navy's unmanned X-47B, aboard USS Theodore Roosevelt in August twenty fourteen.
It shared the deck with fighter jets flown by pilots.
Then it came back around to land on a ship moving through the ocean.
Its tailhook caught one of the steel wires across the deck, which stops a landing jet in about two seconds.
Then the deck crew guided it away and its wings folded up, just like a manned jet.
outcome: The X-47B completed its tests aboard Theodore Roosevelt, operating safely alongside manned aircraft.
title: No pilot, landing on a carrier
description:
The Navy's unmanned X-47B launches from and lands aboard the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71) during flight tests alongside manned aircraft, Aug. 17, 2014.
